title: Outfield
description:
HOW LONG WILL YOU SURVIVE?Outfield is a survival horror roguelite experience set in the tall grass. Every run generates a unique map with its own obstacles, weather conditions and day/night cycle. Destroy scarecrows, collect loot, upgrade your character — and above all, don't make too much noise.

Because something is hunting you. It can't see you. It hears you.

• 🌾 Procedural map — obstacles, weather and atmosphere change every run

• 🔫 One gun. Every shot has a price — sound is your worst enemy

• 👁️ It evolves — the longer you survive, the faster, more aggressive and unpredictable it becomes

• 🌦️ Dynamic day/night cycle and weather — rain masks sounds, night reduces your vision

• 🏆 Beat your record — every run is a new chance to last longer

• 🔍 Explore — secrets, unexpected areas and discoveries are waiting for you in the field

PROGRESSIONDestroy scarecrows to earn XP and level up. At each milestone, choose one upgrade from several random options — speed, more ammo, and more. Every choice shapes your run. No two runs play the same.

How far will you go?
description_short: Оно слышит тебя. Каждый выстрел. Каждый шаг. Выживай в высокой траве, уничтожай чучела. Узнай, что скрывает поле.
